conventions.route_test: exact equality on record field 'route'; endswith('known_s') is a bug because it also matches 'unknown_s'
conventions.non_ok_records: counted as NEITHER contained NOR recovered NOR covered
conventions.authority: producer boolean 'exact_recovery'; recomputed on every ok record
conventions.containment: n_containment / containment use candidate_contains_truth (S subset of HTP candidate) AND status=='ok'; containment_selected uses S subset of selected AND status=='ok'
conventions.strict_simultaneous_coverage: producer field: exact recovery AND computational success AND active_joint_coverage; anything else is noncoverage; denominator = all n_records
conventions.false_negatives_a: false_negative_count_reportable = sum len(false_negatives) over ok/reportable records only
conventions.false_negatives_b: false_negative_count_including_empty_selection = (a) + s * n_empty_selection (each empty selection misses all s actives)
conventions.c2_scope: cell-level frozen classification from work/v26_1f/C2_BOUNDARY_CELLS.json (23 boundary cells, r_on_candidate <= 1.75). No per-record interior/boundary field exists in the raw records, so the unknown_s split by scope is exactly a partition of whole cells.
conventions.standard_errors: binomial MC SE sqrt(phat(1-phat)/n) at the stated denominator; mean_interval_width_se is sd/sqrt(n) over ok records
conventions.false_negative_ses: per-active-coordinate rates use binomial SE at denominator s*n_ok (reportable) or s*n_records (all, empty selections charged s misses each); record-level rates use binomial SE over records. false_positive_rate_per_record_reportable is a mean count per record, so no binomial SE is given (use the record-level false_positive_record_rate_reportable instead).

cells.c2_scope_level: cell (frozen C2_BOUNDARY_CELLS.json); records carry no per-record interior/boundary field
